design.structured: Exact paired baseline cell count; fixed first hand; >=2 distinct shapes with >=2 unique placements; immediate +z clear with witnessed complete three-piece path; bounded search; explicit baseline fallback
design.censoring: Stop after exactly cap successful placements; check terminal state there. Quantiles beyond the observed range are >cap.
design.survival: S(n)=P(successful placements >= n); no win condition
design.pressure: Mobility counts unique occupied-cell placements per distinct remaining shape; tight<=8; samePreHandMobilityReleasePct is a geometric counterfactual: clear followed by SAME PRE-MOVE hand mobility increase >=8, not actual post-move hand recovery.
design.confidence: Wilson intervals quantify Monte Carlo uncertainty under this model/actor only; not model error or real-player confidence intervals. See bySeed for seed sensitivity.

strategies.noise: First playable slot; 25% random unique physical placement, otherwise maximum immediate lines. New geometry enumeration/tie order differs from historical reachability; not a byte-identical historical replay.
strategies.greedy: First playable slot, maximum immediate lines; not optimal.
strategies.space: Across all slots, top-6 by 100000*immediately cleared unique cells + 100*empty shell cells + occupied orthogonal adjacency; select most remaining-hand legal placements, ties use preliminary score. Pruned moves cannot win; no future-deal knowledge; not optimal.
strategies.random: Uniform across legal slot/unique-physical-placement moves; not calibrated to a novice.

design.binning: 12-placement windows, observations conditional on still playing; survivor bias applies.
design.fallbackPolicy: Baseline fallback retained in intention-to-treat comparison; never excluded as a failed sample.
